evidence_rows.locator: 2024 stereoisomer section/Figure 3; 2026 rat section 3.2; worm section 3.3
evidence_rows.observation: P2 is the slower chiral-SFC fraction and the trans-(1R,2R) cyclopropyl article. The 2024 parent-8015 abbreviation is not a safe stand-in for pure P2.
evidence_rows.denominator: 2024 P2 fusogenic concentration-response: four independent experiments; not four human donors.
evidence_rows.limits: A morphology-derived fusion potency is not a human useful-function concentration or clinical exposure target.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Bind every evidence and exposure claim to the exact chemical article.

evidence_rows.observation: The human fibroblast and directly reprogrammed motor-neuron observations used parent 8015 from one T105M patient and measured mitochondrial morphology, polarization and transport.
evidence_rows.denominator: Cell n values include 30–50 mitochondria per cell from 3–4 independent experiments; these are not independent patient denominators.
evidence_rows.limits: No human motor-unit force, transmission or patient efficacy result is supplied by these panels.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Do not credit exact P2 with an already established human functional bridge.

evidence_rows.locator: Evaluation of Mouse Neuromuscular Phenotypes; Figure 5C–G
evidence_rows.observation: Exact P2 treatment followed the approximately 50-week baseline in T105M knock-in mice of both sexes; the reported regimen was 50 mg/kg orally each day for six weeks, with improved motor, sensory and CMAP readouts.
evidence_rows.denominator: Figure 5 says each panel contains animal counts, but image-only counts were not independently recovered in this pass.
evidence_rows.limits: No new effect-size reconstruction, equivalence analysis, or animal-level reanalysis was performed. Functional n values remain unknown rather than borrowed from histology.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Retain an established-disease animal signal with its unresolved precision and design limits.

evidence_rows.locator: Figure 6 legend; Figure 4H–J and accompanying text
evidence_rows.observation: Mouse axon/myocyte histology uses four mice per group; synapse-density histology uses three. The M376V comparison had no measured neuromuscular deficit and was not an exact-P2 nonresponse test.
evidence_rows.denominator: Approximately 100 axon or myocyte measurements contribute to an individual mouse mean; microscopic observations are not animals.
evidence_rows.limits: Neither normal M376V baseline nor the T105M efficacy result establishes broad clinical allele coverage.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Require the claim to match the responding model without rejecting an untested genotype.

evidence_rows.locator: Evaluation of Mouse Neuromuscular Phenotypes; full main-text searches for random/blind
evidence_rows.observation: Mouse rotarod readings were aggregated within each mouse; inverted-grid reporting used the longest trial and preemptively excluded obese mice. A randomization or blinding statement was not recovered from the readable main text.
evidence_rows.denominator: Repeated trials and days are nested within mice.
evidence_rows.limits: Unrecovered reporting is not proof those safeguards were absent. Excluded-animal counts and complete group flow were not recovered.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Independent confirmation has value; do not pool nominal trials as additional biological replication.

evidence_rows.observation: Only males entered rat disease-reversal studies. The initial comparison randomized treatment 2:1 against vehicle after 50-week baseline phenotyping; functional and postmortem analyses were blinded.
evidence_rows.denominator: Individual rats; Figure 5 image-only group counts were not independently transcribed.
evidence_rows.limits: Both sexes in baseline characterization do not establish drug response in females; the ratio alone cannot recover group sizes.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Keep a credible controlled animal comparison while bounding sex and precision generality.

evidence_rows.observation: The rat dose cohorts used 1, 2, 5 or 10 mg/kg, Monday–Friday. Figure 6A states four rats per dose and seven WT references; the 10 mg/kg group ended at four weeks after reaching the authors' normal-range criterion.
evidence_rows.denominator: These counts apply to Figure 6A; they are not imputed into Figure 5 or the separate detailed time-course/histology cohort.
evidence_rows.limits: This is outcome-dependent stopping of the highest-dose dose-response arm, not a verified drug-withdrawal durability study.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Do not treat every regimen as eight weeks of comparable exposure or follow-up.

evidence_rows.observation: The abstract/discussion label 2 mg/kg as minimally effective, while the results say every tested dose showed some benefit. Several 'normalization' claims use nonsignificance versus WT.
evidence_rows.denominator: Four rats per dose and seven WT reference animals for Figure 6A.
evidence_rows.limits: Partial improvement and the authors' fuller-response criterion are distinct. Raw endpoint-specific values, precision and a transferable clinical threshold were not established here.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Retain dose/time responsiveness without creating an absolute pharmacological threshold or a human dosing inference.

evidence_rows.observation: Rat grip reporting selects the maximum of eight readings, CMAP averages three selected best recordings, sensation averages ten readings, and MRI averages the two legs. Results describe front-paw sensitivity, whereas the methods specify hind paws.
evidence_rows.MRI_summary: mean of left and right muscle volume per animal
evidence_rows.denominator: These are within-rat measurement rules, not additional rats. Imaging fields and bilateral limbs do not increase independent animal n.
evidence_rows.limits: The source conflict does not prove a treatment effect is artifactual. The precise sensory site needs clarification for exact transfer.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Preserve the measurement rule and biological unit when judging reproducibility and useful effect.

evidence_rows.observation: Early functional improvement preceded substantial synapse-density recovery; the authors discuss direct muscle effects and possible synaptic sprouting as contributors.
evidence_rows.denominator: Separate time-course and postmortem histology cohorts; complete endpoint-specific counts were not recovered.
evidence_rows.limits: Integrated force and CMAP do not identify a unique neuronal mechanism. Postmortem histology is not assumed to be serial biopsy in the same animal.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Useful muscle or ongoing-control benefit remains valuable; nerve-regrowth and durable regeneration claims require their own evidence.

evidence_rows.locator: Table 1; Figure 2A; Figure 3D/G; Mitofusin Activators methods
evidence_rows.observation: The commonly repeated protein-binding and brain/plasma values belong to parent 8015. Exact-P2 plasma PK used small mouse/rat groups, and its mouse enterohepatic challenge was a separate comparison.
evidence_rows.denominator: PK plasma profiles: n=3 per dose/species as captioned; charcoal comparison: n=4 each. Neither is a human exposure dataset.
evidence_rows.limits: Parent-mixture partitioning and binding cannot establish exact-P2 human free nerve, muscle, cardiac or CNS exposure. PK and efficacy vehicles also differ.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: An exposure-linked functional question remains more informative than a nominal potency comparison.

evidence_rows.locator: Mitofusin Activators methods versus EHR results paragraph
evidence_rows.observation: The charcoal intervention is printed as 2 g/kg in Methods and 2 mg/kg in Results. Both passages refer to the mouse P2 enterohepatic investigation.
evidence_rows.limits: The discrepancy is left unresolved; this pass neither selects a dose nor reruns the published PK model. The published qualitative EHR evidence is retained with a reproducibility limit.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Do not turn a documented PK interpretation into an independently transferable regimen or human exposure guarantee.

evidence_rows.observation: The acute sciatic-nerve motility observations used 100 mg/kg P2; the rat observation was two hours after dosing. Chronic functional efficacy used a different dose and schedule.
evidence_rows.denominator: Rat Figure 5A labels individual ex vivo neuron data; animal n for that assay was not independently recovered.
evidence_rows.limits: Motility is a pharmacodynamic readout, not direct occupancy. Acute high-dose PD cannot establish sustained target engagement or human tissue coverage at the chronic regimen.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Keep target/PD plausibility and useful-dose exposure as distinct decision inputs.

evidence_rows.observation: The active formulation is made from a DMSO stock diluted into hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin; the stated vehicle control is 30% cyclodextrin. Matched final DMSO in the controls is not explicitly documented.
evidence_rows.denominator: Formulation/reporting statement, not an additional efficacy cohort.
evidence_rows.limits: No claim of solvent-induced efficacy or toxicity is made. Powder purity and weekly preparation do not establish clinical-product stability or a qualified human formulation.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Article/formulation qualification is distinct from proof of useful human function; do not price one as though it completes the other.

evidence_rows.locator: Round 5 audited Supplemental Table S1, three pages
evidence_rows.observation: The inherited audit records 75 binding and 12 enzyme/cell rows at 10 micromolar. MAO-A 59% and hERG -14% are binding readouts; the separate MAO-B -5% value is enzymatic.
evidence_rows.denominator: 87 assay rows, not 87 independent safety margins or necessarily 87 unique proteins.
evidence_rows.limits: No new exposure-linked MAO-A function, hERG current or chronic safety result was recovered. The nominal cross-assay ratio is not a universal selectivity ratio; a binding interaction is not a demonstrated clinical adverse event.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Retain the useful preliminary panel and its corrected interpretation without upgrading it to systemic safety.

evidence_rows.locator: Authorship/conflict statements; worm methods/results; exact-name searches on 2026-11-05
evidence_rows.observation: Mouse, rat and worm articles share investigators and a company-linked material lineage. The worm paper is exact-article non-CMT context. This bounded pass recovered no new exact-P2 human useful-function or treated-patient result.
evidence_rows.denominator: No additional human cohort or patient is counted; source and species counts do not equal independent laboratories.
evidence_rows.limits: A bounded search does not prove universal absence. Worm aging findings do not expand this CMT2A program into an aging opportunity or resolve the human bridge.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Close this article lane until a specific functional, exposure, reproducibility or correction artifact can change the continuation decision.

claim_decisions.claim: Exact P2 has a legitimate established-disease animal functional signal.
Useful human function or human clinical efficacy is already established for exact P2.
The current evidence proves all-allele, both-sex CMT2A responsiveness.
claim_decisions.decision: not_established; narrow any initial claim to qualified tested backgrounds

claim_decisions.claim: The published compound-family PK supplies a human systemic therapeutic window for P2.
Nonsignificance against WT establishes complete equivalence or cure.
A direct muscle contribution or need for continued treatment eliminates useful product value.
claim_decisions.decision: reject_universal_rule; require meaningful useful benefit and tolerability for the intended claim

claim_decisions.claim: The single-concentration panel proves a greater-than-10000-fold safety margin, or conversely proves clinical MAO toxicity.
A preliminary article/model qualification deliverable automatically inherits the original rank-six EV.
claim_decisions.decision: reject_automatic_inheritance; recompare actual information yield, remaining cost, time and capture

claim_decisions.claim: The rat minimum-effective statement provides a human dose or exposure threshold.
Multiple species and multiple endpoints are equivalent to independent exact-P2 human replication.
Unrecovered figure counts, source inconsistencies or an unqualified human assay already falsify P2 biology.
